function_signature: def hkdf(ikm, salt, info, length, hash_name='sha256') -> bytes
expected_pass_rate: >= 0.85 (12 test cases in all; the main metric is task_success, scored 0 or 1 for the whole task: it is 1 only if no blocking failure occurs and every functional case passes — the registered process and performance cases are excluded from the functional set but block on failure; the pass-rate threshold on the left and the per-case pass rate are recorded as diagnostics only)
constraints: Use the standard library hmac+hashlib, third-party HKDF banned; extract-then-expand; an empty salt uses all 0; length<=255*HashLen or ValueError; deterministic, returning bytes
